limitation: This first stage independently reads implementation, pinned backend excerpts and meaningful archived assertion/replay evidence. Fresh successor-specific independent tests follow author commits. No production/native effects are inferred.

findings.impact: The confidentiality editor closes on same-ID response retaining all-viewers after uploader-only was requested. This can mislead a user about access restriction; no native disclosure or authorization bypass was demonstrated.
findings.currentContract: 243248e client-files.controller setAccess139–175 returns ID, viewerMode, normalized unique trimmed viewerUserIds and uploadedByUserId. Exact semantic receipt comparison is available; no new endpoint required. Folder bulk access separately returns folder/mode/IDs/count.
findings.independentTestReview: The existing browser control changes actual UI to Specific people/no selected users, intercepts PATCH, returns real-shaped unchanged file, and observes editor dismissal. It demonstrates frontend receipt handling rather than server ACL enforcement.
repairReviewRequirements: Compare normalized requested ACL, not raw viewer ordering/duplicates.
Preserve review/draft on incompatible receipt; distinguish uncertain completion from confirmed refusal.
Retain actor/client current-reader boundaries and authority replacement.

findings.impact: Enabled artifact writes accept HTTP200 arbitrary bodies and clear editing state, losing reviewed draft without available identity/context validation. Create is browser-proven; other actions share source, not separately native-qualified.
findings.currentContract: 243248e noteMetadataSelect11009 and debriefMetadataSelect11031 provide ID/meeting/client/author/status/confidential/timestamps. shareArtifacts1844 and unshareArtifacts1913 return a decorated meeting. Validators must be action-specific.
findings.independentTestReview: The control injects {saved:false, foreign meeting/client} with unchanged GET, then verifies note draft is no longer editable. This is meaningful negative receipt evidence. It does not prove backend emits malformed receipts.
repairReviewRequirements: Validate metadata on save/approve and meeting receipt on share/unshare against original reviewed scope.
Do not demand body plaintext where backend returns metadata only.
Preserve intent after unknown outcome; avoid automatic write retry.

findings.impact: After an uncertain503 creation response a second ordinary click emits a second POST. Backend current create calls .create without a request-key deduplication contract. Duplicate persistence is possible but no native duplicate records were created.
findings.currentContract: 243248e createMeetingNote5733–5767 and createMeetingDebrief5831–5860 have body/confidential/accessLevel/approved inputs and direct create. No request ID or replay deduplication is exposed. Browser abort does not cancel the durable effect.
findings.independentTestReview: The503 then deliberate second-click proof is distinct from synthetic same-tick submit-event proof. The latter tests synchronous guard absence, not a claim about ordinary user double-click dispatch. Debrief currently shares the hook.
repairReviewRequirements: Retain uncertain creation state and prevent blind repeat POST, including reopen if retained lifecycle supports it.
Do not acknowledge newly created record by body similarity or ordering without durable identity.

findings.impact: Typing after Save while PATCH is held is accepted, but successful valid PATCH/snapshot and journal clearing remount DraftEditor and discard later input. This needs no malformed backend receipt.
findings.currentContract: Existing manual draft update and snapshot are separate operations, with exact prospect origin and returned content validation. Journal reserves/rechecks actor, current document and baseline before update; success acknowledges retained intent then remounts local editor. The fix must not replace that journal/authority owner.
findings.independentTestReview: The test holds actual intercepted PATCH, types different later input, returns matching submitted content and a valid snapshot, then observes initial input restored. Multiple independent archived replays confirm the same baseline.
repairReviewRequirements: Disable all editable prospect title/section fields throughout reserve/read/update/snapshot/acknowledge pending, or preserve later draft explicitly.
Hold PATCH and snapshot separately in tests.
Keep uncertain saved input, deliberate read-current recovery, immutable prospect origin and actor/session replacement intact.

findings.impact: Existing subscribers can enter Add profiles then Review checkout, but selected backend operation creates a new subscription Checkout Session using absolute quantity. Duplicate charges/subscriptions were not executed or claimed.
findings.currentContract: Current243248e billing service is byte-identical to prior4be13b0 snapshot. createCheckoutSession95–145 always mode subscription; ensureCustomer only reuses customer. createPortalSession148–166 supplies the existing hosted quantity/payment/invoice management owner. Controller summary comment saying checkout add slots is contradicted by service implementation.
findings.independentTestReview: Baseline preview did not submit Checkout, avoiding a provider action. Frontend operation route plus exact service source establishes the mismatch. Successor request tests must intercept all provider navigation and HTTP.
repairReviewRequirements: hasSubscription true never dispatches checkout for capacity management, including past_due/incomplete/canceled states.
Reread current billing state/summary before dispatch and refuse unavailable or contradictory state.
Truthful hosted portal copy; provider configuration and actual billing-admin outcomes remain unqualified.
Retain synchronous action lock, scope abort and safe destination validation.
